callback_completion_reduction_review.question: Can fCallback and the late stack.completed assignment be merged without changing failure semantics?
callback_completion_reduction_review.scope: Read-only closure review of all five hook conversions and wow_message_stack_leave; no production edits.
observations: CallWndProc, CBT, MsgFilter, Journal and Mouse save CallBack16 result and set completed only after output conversion and normal release.
Journal and Mouse finally call wow_message_stack_leave(&stack,FALSE). The callee restores the saved cursor iff !completed or abnormal, and preserves LastError.

Therefore assigning completed immediately at successful CallBack16 changes the post-callback exception path: current completed remains FALSE, while an early assignment leaves TRUE and abnormal is explicitly FALSE.

CallWndProc, CBT and MsgFilter have nested cleanup finally scopes and capture incomplete status before cleanup; AbnormalTermination must be evaluated in the intended scope, not assumed to describe the outer conversion.
No evidence here establishes that output conversion actually throws in deployed guest operation. This is a source-level distinction, not a reproduced defect.
callback_completion_reduction_review.decision: Reject mechanical five-family substitution. A reduced design must preserve completion phase or carry outer abnormal termination correctly; this finding alone does not approve retaining all existing lifetime diffs.
callback_completion_reduction_review.next: Compare original stack ownership and full output/free closure before selecting a minimal candidate; do not mark R1722 or the file complete from this finding.
